import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if len(data) < 2:
        return
    n = int(data[0])  # not used, but read to match input format
    s = data[1]
    count = 0
    max_len = 0
    start = -1
    inside = False
    for i, ch in enumerate(s):
        if ch == '_':
            if start != i - 1:
                if inside:
                    count += 1
                else:
                    max_len = max(max_len, i - 1 - start)
            start = i
        elif ch == '(':
            inside = True
            if start != i - 1:
                max_len = max(max_len, i - 1 - start)
            start = i
        elif ch == ')':
            inside = False
            if start != i - 1:
                count += 1
            start = i
    if start != len(s) - 1:
        max_len = max(max_len, len(s) - 1 - start)
    print(f"{max_len} {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
